# Vendored CRDs

Unmodified copies, installed into envtest so the integration and acceptance
suites wait on the real schemas. Both are Apache-2.0.

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `nvcre.nvidia.com_certifications.yaml` | [NVIDIA/cluster-readiness-engine](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cluster-readiness-engine) v0.2.0, `helm/cluster-readiness-engine/crds/nvcre.nvidia.com_certifications.yaml` |
| `trainer.kubeflow.org_trainjobs.yaml` | [kubeflow/trainer](https://github.com/kubeflow/trainer) v2.2.0, `manifests/base/crds/trainer.kubeflow.org_trainjobs.yaml` |
